subject: Port 9 — the prototype, as promised
body:
Hi Nury,

Good talking to you earlier today. Here is the prototype:

https://sindrimar02.github.io/port9-preview/

frumgerd-port9.jpg

I built it because Port 9 already has a real identity — the candlelight, the wine, the exhibitions and the concerts — and almost none of it reaches anyone before they walk through the door. This puts it on screen, with the whole wine list in real text, so people find you by the wines you actually pour instead of scrolling through photos of a printed sheet.

And the timing fits better than I realised on the phone. A new brand book needs somewhere to land, and this is built to carry one: colours, type and voice drop straight into it, and it is quick to change once you have decided. Nothing in it is fixed — think of it as the shape of the new chapter rather than the finished thing.

It is in Icelandic for now; a full English version is part of the build, the same way your site has both today.

No rush at all. Open it on your phone in the meeting on Thursday if that is easiest, and get back to me once you and the team have talked.

Best,
Sindri Már
845 1758
sndrstudio.is
note: Follow-up to the phone call 2026-09-10 14:04. Supersedes the cold Icelandic pitch to info@port9.is.
